title: Server-side fetch of assembled URL (apex) — review required
description: A apex HTTP client fetches a URL assembled from parts: setEndpoints*([^)]*+. Untrusted input in the URL reaches internal hosts, metadata endpoints, and file URLs. This lexical rule flags the fetch; the reviewer confirms the host is fixed or allowlisted.
remediation: Fetch only allowlisted hosts (a Named Credential endpoint); block metadata ranges, localhost, and non-HTTP schemes, and disable redirects or re-validate them.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any assembled fetch URL matches, including trusted ones.
